limitations: This packet is a screened source-set excerpt, not a complete global inventory.
Point and editorial state locators do not establish whole-feature physical containment.
Scientific claims and public release remain under review.

geometries.method: Editorial point on the southern Portuguese slope near the float-observed Mediterranean Undercurrent; not a source core position, path, or length endpoint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: RAFOS floats and hydrography track the undercurrent from the Gulf of Cádiz around southwestern Portugal, where a roughly 30 km wide jet weakens and broadens northward. That width is cross-stream, not its length; branching and loss from the slope prevent a single measured endpoint here.
